notes.title: 2 Play Modes Available! Completely avoid motion sickness in Classic Mode!
notes.notes:
Changes in Version 1.0.6

[list]
[*] Now you can play in Classic Mode and Original Mode: Classic means you apply the force directly into the marble (like other marble's games), and original is rotating the world. Also Classic mode has a 2D camera movement, and it allows you to play the entire game avoiding motion sickness.

[*] The problem to Get 3 stars when collect all stars and all hourglasses in all levels in all difficulties is fixed.

[*] Monster falling through the floor while streaming or recording with OBS is fixed.
[/list]
 
Enjoy!

notes.title: New Update to Version 1.0.5 Released
notes.notes:
Changes in Version 1.0.5
[list]
[*] The number of stars required to get PowerUps where adjusted to improve user experience.
[*] Now when you get all hourglasses in every level you'll receive one PowerUp.
[*] Level 1 in easy mode is really easier now, allowing unexperienced user to win this level.
[*] Minor bugs in gameplay are fixed. 
[/list]

Enjoy!

 - Especial thanks to Rxbbit for all the recommendations! -

notes.title: Escape from the Marble Monster is Ready! Get it on May31,2023
notes.notes:
After more than a year working on it, the game is ready!.
41 challenging  levels including the level 0 as tutorial, in 3 different difficulties are included in this version 1.0.0 of Escape from the Marble Monster. Also the Demo version is already here, give a try! and share with your friends!
